emails.subject: 💸 Vroom Vroom to $20k+ Nano Flips Issue #1
emails.content:
Welcome to the first Nano Flips Newsletter!

​
​

As we dove into putting together the first newsletter, several questions popped up.

​

  1. Should we do an expensive site? Or more affordable one
  2. How many people will actually open up the email?
  3. Is this a terrible idea?

​
Well, questions 2 and 3 are up in the air. But question 1? That one was decided for us. We are going to look at whatever good opportunities come our way! So make sure the newsletter is marked as important and not going to the promotional folder of Gmail (90% of you use Gmail - wow google has a foothold).

​

Today we are going to look at a website that could be bought for $5000 (It's currently listed under that at the time of writing this).

​

With a little effort. we are going to get more like $20k+ out of it in the next 12 months. Don't worry this is pretty simple and easy, part-time stuff.

​

Let's dive in!

​

The Site

​

​

Its a motorcycle site, you can check it out here​

​

​

Lets look at several reasons that this site might be a decent buy, that could be ripe for flipping:

​

  • Its monetized with Adsense
  • It has had stable traffic over the last 12+ months
  • It has a niche focus
  • Its getting traffic from several sources
  • It has a DA of 43
  • Traffic is coming from tier one countries
  • Seller has a good reputation

​

Now, let's take a look at the things we don't like about it.

​

  • Most of the traffic is coming from sharing on social media (takes time)
  • Its traffic to images
  • Revenue is pretty low (not massive growth to squeeze out without growing traffic
  • WE WANT TO MAKE SURE BUYER IS INCLUDING ALL SOCIAL MEDIA PROFILES
  • Traffic isn't SUPER stable

​

There are several things we can do here to make it more valuable. Let's take a look.

​

The Plan

​

  • We are going to change out Adsense for a premium ad network! We are going to probably go with something like Ezoic. The larger ones won't take the site. But we might try! Automatad, Adpushup, Adthrive, Mediavine, Lockerdome. There are more, but that would be a good start. This is probably going to increase revenue by 50% or more.

​

  • Build out a blog! 2 points of attack here, first is going to be finding low-hanging keywords, that we can rank for easily using a tool like Ahrefs or SEMrush. We are going to write an original piece on Harleys or motorcycles 2-3x a week, this will increase traffic AND revenue, we might even to content to monetize with Amazon affiliates. This is ALSO going to allow us to sell a sponsored post ever other week as well. With a DA of 43, getting $100 or so shouldnt be too hard. Make sure your ratio of fresh content to sponsored posts is high. Google doesn't like you selling these things.

​

  • Make a Facebook Group! I know, you thought I was going to say make a newsletter! I dont think the traffic is compelling enough currently unless you LOVE motorcycles and you find it fun. Build a pop up that direct people to your FB group where they can chat and share their love of motorcycles together. I would say its fair to get 300+ new people a month, who share it with their friends as well. I would think a reasonable goal here is 5-10k members by the end of the year. Later on you can sell sponsorship space in the group, or charge people to list their bikes for sale.

​

If you are good at this, THIS WILL BE A MASSIVE MONEY MAKER FOR YOU. But let's assume you aren't, you still are going to pull $200 a month from selling a sponsor banner ad slot at the top of the FB group.

​

The Profit

​

1.Well first off the site was making $156 a month before from Adsense. ASSUMING WE DONT GROW THE SITE AT ALL (we will), that becomes $234 a month at a 50% increase in revenue with a premium ad network.

​

2. The new blog exists! In fact, we are probably going to go greatly increase traffic with lots of great new content. But let's assume we just keep doing what we were before and making image posts to Pinterest and the like. BUT we are selling 2 sponsored posts a month at $100 each. That's $200 more a month.

​

3. The new Facebook group exists! Let's be conservative and assume you don't have enough members or sell sponsorship at all until 6 months in. Later on, though we are making $200 a month!

​

If we add all those up we get a new net monthly income of $634 a month.

​

For the first 6 months, we are only earning $434 a month.

​

For the year our new total income is $6408, you paid $5000, so your cash on cash return 128.16%

​

We now have a site that we are going to sell for 3x yearly net rev OR $19,224

​

When you add those together and subtract costs, the net profit in 12 months is.......

​

$20,632.00

​

Now I know what you are all saying, "ONLY $20k"!? Well first off guys, this is pretty conservative. This also probably could be done in 4 hours a week. OR 200 hours over the year or $100 an hour for your time. NOT a terrible side income, that's for sure.

​

Well, that's it! That's it for issue #1 of Nano Flips. Keep your eyes peeled, as these will go out as opportunities arise, sometimes they will be $20k profits, sometimes $1 million or more.

​

Thanks from the Nano Flips team

​

(James)

​

P.S.

​

emails.subject: 💸 We Dive Deep for $40k+ Nano Flips Issue #2
emails.content:
Welcome to the Nano Flips Issue #2!

​
​A new opportunity with a commercial diving blog.

​

Sponsored by

Sqribble

What if you could create beautiful eBooks in under 60 seconds? Here’s a tool you gotta see people…. This is perfect for creating products, and lead gen reports. Watch this video to see how fast this process can be ⬇️⬇️⬇️

​

​

​
The site today is a little different than the ones highlighted before.

Today we are going to look at a website that could be bought for $22500 (It's currently listed at that at the time of writing this).

​

This is probably a decent buy and hold opportunity. With a little effort, we are going to get more like $40k+ out of it in the next 12 months. Don't worry this is pretty simple and easy, part-time stuff.

​

Let's dive in!

​

The Site

​

Its a commercial diving site, you can check it out here​

​

They make their money with display ads and selling leads to commercial diving schools on a subscription basis.

​

​

Let's look at several reasons that this site might be a decent buy, that could be ripe for flipping:

​

  • The site looks terrible, a good overhaul could increase current revenue drivers
  • It has had stable traffic over the last 12+ months
  • It has a niche focus
  • Its getting traffic from organic
  • It has a DA of 43
  • Traffic is coming from tier one countries
  • The Seller has a good reputation
  • The niche is evergreen (not seasonal)

​

Now, let's take a look at the things we don't like about it.

​

  • It's already monetized by a premium ad network
  • It already has an email list
  • Not a super fun niche to write about or work on
  • They have already set up back end monetization like lead gen

​

There are several things we can do here to make it more valuable. Let's take a look.

​

The Plan

​

  • We are going to have the site redesigned and optimized for ads! So this site is NOT set up to get revenue in the door. Its bounce rate is also 85%. This tells me with some good optimization we could get it down to 50%. That alone increases ad rev by 35%, but I would assume with some better placements? We could squeeze out a 50% increase in display revenue alone.

​

  • Build out its content much more! They have content, but we want to build out more, enough that we can sell guest posts for $125 a pop once a week. With the sites DA, that's totally possible. With that said, we are going to have to dive in Ahrefs and find more keywords and more content to put up. Let's say we are doing 3 originals a week to blend in the paid content and grow the traffic. You want to start ranking for some of this review content and make more money from amazon associates.

​

  • Fix its crappy lead magnet! Ok guys I get it, but it asks for your full address. They are asking that to sell the lead to schools. Kudos! That's a good idea! But they are losing TONS of people that way. We want the lead magnet sign up to be clean and simple BUT 2 PAGES. So when it pops up? Name and email with a "next button", the next will submit them as a sign-up, page 2 will ask for their address to sell to the diving schools. You will have a much larger list. Create an info product. Sell it. Sell their info to schools again.

​

  • Fix their jobs page! I like the idea that they have a jobs page, but there is nothing there. YOU NEED TO BUILD THAT OUT. If you want to be lazy, just take an affiliate deal with indeed or monster.com, embed their feed, and be done. Maybe you will make $100 more that way? No idea. The smarter move is to reach out to the schools paying you for the leads, try and strike a similar deal with company's they float business to. But let's keep it conservative and say you could make $100 more a month here.

​

  • Link build - increase traffic! A quick look at their Ahrefs will show you that they could rank a little higher here. Without much difficulty. I'll let you dig in, but safe to say them jumping to top 3 for some terms would double their traffic. Let's assume though, that from your new content and link building, you don't DOUBLE the traffic. But you very conservatively add 25% to it.

​

Sponsored by Sqribble​

If you’re looking for a side hustle or even a full-time freelance career from home, then this tool could be your catalyst. It allows you to quickly and easily create eBooks, reports, and whitepapers for clients in seconds — the kind of work they’re currently paying $100’s per day for people to do. This is going to change some people’s lives in incredible ways. Check it out here. Or below ⬇️

​

​

​

The Profit

​

1.Well first off the site was making $150 when we bought it in display ads (media vine). Let's assume we do 2 things we discussed above. The optimization to increase ad RPM by 50% and the 25% increase in traffic. New monthly display revenue should be around $281.25

​

2. The new blog exists! In fact, we are probably going to start recognizing real revenue from amazon associates (It currently makes a tiny amount according to their P&L, we can say $25 a month), but let's assume we don't grow that with new content, even though we will. We are selling $500 of sponsored posts a month. Our new blog income is $525 a month!

​

3. We have a better lead capture form. I'm not going to speculate on what that does for revenue. Could be $0, could be $500+ because of how we monetize the list. Let's say $0 to be safe.

​

4. Jobs page! Our new and improved jobs page isn't going to bring in much. Maybe $100.

​

5. Lead gen to the schools! Let's say we increase traffic 25% as planned, well we are going to increase their fee by 10%. More than fair. Right? That brings that up to $550 a month

​

If we add all those up we get a new net monthly income of....$1456.25

​

For the first 3 months, rev stays the same while we make improvements, we earn $792 per month, so a total of $2376

​

The next 9 months comes out to $13106.25

​

For the year our new total income is $15,482.25, you paid $22,500, so your cash on cash return 68.8%

���

We now have a site that we are going to sell for 3x yearly net rev OR $46,446.75

​

When you add those together and subtract costs, the net profit in 12 months is.......

​

$39,429.00

​

Not bad right? This probably could be done in 3-4 hours a week. Maybe $3k in a site redesign, some backlinks and hosting. You're still up $36k.

​

Well, that's it!

​

That's it for issue #2 of Nano Flips. Maybe this site is for you, maybe its not.

​

Im NOT telling you to go buy this website.Whats important is the frame work and thinking that comes from this, so that you can apply these for your own sites and acqusitions.

​

Thanks from the Nano Flips team

​

(James)

​

​

​

​

​
Brand new site today here you guys, another one from Flippa.

​

Today we are going to look at a website that could be bought for $36,000 (It's currently listed at 18k but 36k is the reserve).

​

At this price, its fair, and a decent buy and hold. But in reality we are going to look at how to improve it and flip it for some massive profits.

​

Let's dive in!

​

The Site

​

Its a gardening blog, you can check it out here​

​

They make their money with Ezoic and Google Adsense. Or what we might call display ads.

​

​

Let's look at several reasons that this site might be a decent buy, that could be perfect for flipping and or holding:

​

  • It has had stable traffic over the last 12+ months
  • It has a niche focus
  • Its getting traffic from pinterest
  • It has a DA of 27
  • Traffic is coming from tier one countries
  • The niche is evergreen (not seasonal)
  • Nobody has worked on it in months, but still earning
  • No effort was put towards SEO

​

Now, let's take a look at the things we don't like about it.

​

  • It's already monetized by a premium ad network (partially)
  • Its mostly getting traffic from 1 social channel (Pinterest)
  • Not a super fun niche to write about or work on (for me personally)
  • No email list set up yet

​

There are several things we can do here to make it more valuable. Let's take a look.

​

The Plan

​

  • We are going to try and take this site to a new ad network! So luckily this site is doing over 50k uniques a month, which should allow us to play with more premium ad networks. To be clear, half the ads are for ezoic, so Im not sure there is much to squeeze out of this side of it. BUT at a bare minium ar are going to bring the whole thing to Ezoic. I would assume a 25% increase here in RPM, as Ezoic pitches a 50% increase, and we are moving half our traffic over to them. If you can get her on ad thrive or media vine, we might get even more. For now? 25% increase.

​

  • Do some on page SEO and a bit of link building! Not sure of the total return on this, but i have the SEMRush report and there are PLENTY of keywords in the 60 range to rank for. Easy low hanging fruit to improve on traffic. Also lets build out some gardening product review articles and maybe some amazon associates to monetize. Some basic link building will help here as well. You will gain traffic from all of this, but we are going to pretend you wont. (YOU WILL)

emails.subject: 💸 $1000? Flipping Sites on a Budget - Nano Flips Issue #4
emails.content:
Welcome to the Nano Flips Issue #4!

​
Are there ways to get into website flipping for less than $1000?

YES

There are 3 clear methods, we will just touch on one of them here.

​

Sponsored by

Sqribble

What if you could create beautiful eBooks in under 60 seconds? Here’s a tool you gotta see people…. This is perfect for creating products, and lead gen reports. Watch this video to see how fast this process can be ⬇️⬇️⬇️

​

​

​
​Expired Domains, and Building on Them

​

For less then $1000 dollars we can find expired domains, with LOTS of domain authority and SEO juice.

​
To keep it simple, we will buy these up, build up some content on them.

​

From there we can sell them directly to people who want to use them as part of private blog networks

​

OR

​

We can gather a little traffic (easy to get since they have HUGE authority, and some are ALREADY getting traffic), place adsense ads, and sell sponsored posts and quickly flip them for a profit 6 months down the line.

​

In the future, we will break that down step by step. For now, my friend Sean Markey did an awesome guest post on finding the right domans to use.

​

Here we go:

​

"Hi, I’m Sean Markey, an SEO expert that’s learned everything the hard way and someone that’s built multiple affiliate sites to 4-5 figures per month, as well as sold a site for well into six-figures.

​

In this piece, I’m going to take you through at a very high level, how to buy a domain with a robust history and valuable backlinks already built, how to build out a site that should get some fairly quick traction, and why you want to do this. Here we go.

​

Why Build on Domains With a History

​

Every day tens-of-thousands of domain names expire. Most of them are terrible garbage names that people register with the grandest of intentions, but never get around to building on. Some of them, however, used to be businesses that someone pinned all their hopes and dreams on, spent thousands of hours creating and publishing content, building links through hard-earned PR. In the end, entropy gets us all, and as the hilarious and very successful comedian Conan O’Brien said: “eventually, all our graves go unattended.”

​

So it goes with businesses! But their loss is your incredible gain.

​

Rather than building a site on a brand new domain that’s never been seen in the world before, one in which people (and search engine algorithms) inherently do not trust because it is so new, so untested, you can pick up the carcass of someone’s failed dream and build something amazing upon it. Buying a site that has hundreds or thousands of links going to it and is already indexed in Google’s algorithm lets you cut to the front of the line, essentially, and build something that gets search engine ranking traffic a lot more quickly.

​

How to Find a Domain With SEO Juice

​

There’s definitely an art to finding domains with existing authority among all the trash expiring every day, and I’m going to give you the 80/20.

​

1. Look at GoDaddy Auctions and Sort by Number of Bids

​

GoDaddy is the place to go for valuable expiring domains because they’ve got the biggest volume. Several other registrars funnel their expiring domains through the GoDaddy auction system, so just as you wouldn’t pan for gold in a swamp, don’t overthink where to look for good expiring domains—GoDaddy is where it’s at.

​

Once you visit auctions.godaddy.com, you’ll need to sign up for an auction account—that’s $4.99 per year. Now you can bid on domains!

​

To find the auctions that are valuable (either because the domain itself is valuable, or because it has valuable backlinks, you just need to do this:

​

Click “Advanced Search”

​

Select “contains” from the drop-down menu and leave it blank (top left)

​

Click “expiring auction” (bottom left)

​

Click “search” (bottom right)

​

Now, just sort the list of domains you get by “number of bids.” Put any domains that seem to have a lot of bids but is clearly not a premium one-word domain name into your favorite SEO tool (I prefer ahrefs.com) and see what kind of links it already has.

​

Sponsored by Sqribble​

If you’re looking for a side hustle or even a full-time freelance career from home, then this tool could be your catalyst. It allows you to quickly and easily create eBooks, reports, and whitepapers for clients in seconds — the kind of work they’re currently paying $100’s per day for people to do. This is going to change some people’s lives in incredible ways. Check it out here. Or below ⬇️

​

​

​

2. Use ExpiredDomains.net to Find Other Good Opportunities

​

This popular (and free!) tool gets a lot of use from people looking to find expired domains with authority. You can sort by number of backlinks, number of organic search volume, and other interesting filters.

​

You’ll get better at searching the more you do it, so practicing with this site is highly recommended if you’re a beginner.

​

3. Use a Paid Tool Like DomCop.com or spamzilla.io to Find Domains

​

If you’ve got some money to throw at the problem, these two paid tools are highly recommended. If you know what you’re doing (by which I mean, if you have SEO experience) you can sort by a ton more metrics here than on expireddomains.net. These tools will give you a feed of all expiring domains at ALL platforms, and let you search by Moz DA, Ahrefs DR, Majestic CF/TF, or other amazing filters like “topical relevancy of backlinks.”

​

What to Do Once You’ve Acquired a Domain With Juice

​

A mistake a lot of domain-buyers make is to just go in once they have control of the domain and 301 it at the register to another site they are trying to rank well (this is because a large majority of people buying expired domains do so with the intention of helping a site they’re already building vs. building new).

​

But I’m going to assume you’re looking for a project to build out and not boost another, so that’s how the advice will flow.

​

First, you want to get the domain live. My suggestion is always “never skimp on hosting.” Find a nice WP managed host for your Wordpress site and push it live. Next, you want to get SOMETHING live on it as soon as you can. This is because the longer the site is down, the more links it loses and the more authority gets washed away. So your first goal should be to get a site live with like, a few blog posts, a home page, an about/contact page, at minimum.

​

Now you can take things a bit slowly, since you’re not in danger of losing authority and trust.

​

Do some keyword research and find some ideal keywords to write about, keywords you want to rank for. The authority your site has will help you with this. No tricks here, just… build a good site, consistently post content, and try and build on a clean, attractive design.

​

Finally, look in a tool like Ahrefs and find the most linked-to pages on the site…these will probably be the main pages on the site-that-used-to-be-built on this domain, or any article that went a bit viral. Most likely, these pages won’t be relevant to the site you’re building, but you can still capture some value.

​

Here’s what you do:

​

Find these well-linked-to pages using Ahrefs’ “best pages by links”

​

Ignore the home page, find old inner pages with links

​

Download a plugin like “Redirection” and redirect these names with a lot of links to /blog page, or to a similar other “general” page.

​

That’s it.

​

Now you’ve a site that has existing authority and is well-poised to start getting organic traffic from all the great content you’re now posting. "

​

That's it for issue #4 of Nano Flips. As we said, this is the tip of the ice berg of this method.

​

Keep your eyes peeled for newsletters on the topid

​

Thanks from the Nano Flips team

​

(James)

​

P.S.

​

Pulling $25k from an auto parts website.

At this price, its fair, and a decent buy and hold. But there are some MAJOR opportunities with it, quick easy wins that will increase its value pretty quickly.

I have recorded a youtube video to go with it - so make sure to watch the video all the way through (and like and subscribe)

​

Ill go into more detail below

The Video

​

 
 

​

​

If the video doesnt work above its here​

You can check out the listng for the site here​

​

They make their money Google Adsense. Or "display ads." Which is the lowest hanging fruit of monetization.

​

​

​

Let's look at several reasons that this site might be a decent buy, that could be perfect for flipping and or holding:

​

  • It has had stable traffic over the last 12+ months
  • It has a niche focus - auto parts!
  • Its getting most of its traffic from Google search
  • It has a DA of 44
  • Traffic is coming from tier one countries (mostly US)
  • The niche is evergreen (not seasonal)
  • Great opportunity to monetize better
  • Great opportunity to grow traffic
  • No email list yet

​

Now, let's take a look at the things we don't like about it.

​

  • It's in a very specific niche, that becomes easier to write about if you love it
  • Its traffic is mostly coming from one source
  • Seller is a Flipper, so they have squeezed some of the juice out of the site already

​

There are several things we can do here to make it more valuable. Let's take a look.

​

The Plan

​

  • We are going to try and take this site to a new ad network! Sadly we are just under the threshold needed to qualify for a premium network like an Ezoic. So once we grow this site to over 10k pageviews a month, we are going to try and move it to Ezoic. This will likely result in a 10-50% increase in revenue. Lets assume 25% to be safe. AND lets assume it takes us 6 months to get it there.

​

  • Do some on page SEO and a bit of link building! Lots and lots of opportunity in the car parts space, there is almost an unlimited amount of content and buyer keywords to write about here. With some basic work, lets assume we can improve traffic. It might double or triple, but on the SUPER SAFE SIDE. Lets just assume that at the end of the year we can add 25% to the monthly traffic.

​

  • Create lead magnet and newsletter! 5k UNIQUES A MONTH. You guys, lets just just assume you can grab a small portion of that, 2.5%. We are looking at 125 new subs a month...or a very solid 1,500 at the end of the year (if we dont grow). This will become super useful for selling sponsored blasts AND sending traffic back to the site.

​

  • Add affiliate links to the site for car insurance and car parts: Im going to try and guess how much you could make from an auto parts affiliate program. Its going to be out of thin air, but lets say you cut used the program from Advanced Auto Parts. And you made $4 per an an article, per month, and you ad 5 articles a month here about parts. Lets also assume, we convert 1% of visitors into a lead for a auto insurance phone call. (see in video)

​

  • Sell Email Sponsorship - So this is bad AND good. I don't think you will be able to sell sponsorship YET. BUT after a year, this will be part of the upside and reason you can sell it, let the buyer know what an amazing opportunity it will be once there are a few thousand subscribers. In the mean time, on a weekly basis, mail them a round up of the new content you are putting out. This will help you with the sale

​

  • Sell Guest Posts! - Ok you aren't going to make much here, but we need good fresh content for the site anyway. You are going to maybe make $100 a month here selling 1 every week EASILY. Use the money to offset some of your costs. You are going to be adding 4-5 non paid articles monthly anyway.

​

The Profit

​

1.Well first off the site was making $426 p/mo when we bought it in display ads (adsense). Let's assume we do the things we discussed above. The optimization to increase ad RPM by 25%, we only get to do that 6 months in when we are at 10k pageviews a month. To keep it simple, we can pretend that ad revenue stays the same for the first 6 months, and after that, hits roughly $650 a month.

​

2. We now have some affiliate programs running on new content that we are adding to the site weekly. We are using SUPER conservative numbers here guys, and going to assume that we add 5 a month and earn an average of $4 from each of them. So we are adding $20 a month to revenue.

​

3. We are selling sponsored posts. Nothing crazy, but we can easily grab another $100 a month here. (Id say $300+ is actually doable)

​

At the end of 12 months our new monthly income of....$990+

​

Over the next 12 months, we are earned $9216.00+

​

You paid $10000, so your cash on cash return 92.16%

​

We now have a site that we are going to sell for 3x yearly net rev OR $27,648

​

When you add those together and subtract costs, the net profit in 12 months is.......

​

$26,864

​

​

​

Not bad right? This probably could be done in 1-2 hours a week. If you want to hold this for 2 years and keep up the work? You would make A LOT MORE. MORE AROUND $50-75K, but $25k for 100 or so hours of work isn't the end of the world ha. These numbers are conservative, if you want, subtract another $200 from your total for hosting and Yoast the SEO plugin.

​

Also, we could get MUCH more agressive on the content creation and SEO and really really knock this out the park.

​

Well, that's it!

​

That's it for issue #6 of Nano Flips. Maybe this site is for you, maybe its not.

​

As always! Im NOT telling you to go buy this website.Whats important is the frame work and thinking that comes from this, so that you can apply these for your own sites and acquisitions.

​

Thanks from the Nano Flips team

​

(James)

emails.subject: 💸 flipping for fun & profit
emails.content:
Hey, it’s James.

We have opened up the Special Edition Nano Flips "Digital Real Estate Empire" Mentorship Program.

And I just gotta say...

CONGRATULATIONS if you locked in your spot already!

TRUST ME...

The magic of flipping is about to get very real.

I’m working through the email questions from some of you right now.

But I just wanted to take a quick break to tell you WHY I like this opportunity so much...

And why I’m so pumped to peel back the curtain for you.

(BTW, if you don't want hear more about this offer, just click here.)

So back when I was 26-27 I’d had a my first exit.

And sure, I blew some cash or whatever...

I was a young guy and that’s kind of a rite of passage at that age.

But then I thought I’d go and give this “digital nomad” thing a try.

So I was traveling around Thailand, Cambodia, Bali, just seeing South East Asia generally.

And let me tell you…

That kind of freedom is something else.

It’s VERY different from a vacation.

Because most people go on vacay and work half the time.

But if you do it right?

You get a long stretch of time to FULLY defragment and work out what YOU really want to FOCUS on in your life.

It’s not something our parents had, just working from anywhere or taking a sabbatical when you need to recharge

I’s a bit more common now, people doing this kind of stuff...

But back then?

It wasn’t something the average person could do.

Real talk: it’s empowering to run things from a laptop while you admire the beautiful view and sip on some fresh coffee.

You’re just thinking… “Hmm shall I go for a massage or shall I make some more money?”

But to do this?

First, you gotta get FREE.

And as I said a couple of emails ago…

If you’re built anything like me…

This sort of life loses its shine quickly.

After about a year I went back to building.

Or I should say...

I went back to helping OTHERS build.

I didn’t want to give up the lifestyle, necessarily.

But I did want to get my hands dirty again.

So I started helping out with mentorship programs.

I helped out with a few, but Google Launchpad was the main one.

Why am I telling you this?

2 reasons, and then I’m going to get back to your emails…
​

  1. I believe that, with the way the world is changing, faster than ever before… It’s IMPERATIVE to separate yourself from a job and a fixed location ASAP. It’s straightforward to do by learning very simple skills that, once understood, can be easily outsourced. I am going to take you through all of this, step-by-step, in the mentorship program.
    ​
  2. I want to make it clear to anyone “on the fence” about this opportunity that I know EXACTLY what I am doing. I have been successful enough at a young age to not just make big money flipping digital real estate but also to be trusted by Google to mentor people in online business.

​

Sure, you can go rogue and do some freelancing or consulting (did this too)...

But let me tell you…

Nothing…

NOTHING

Beats building out your own business.

If you take this opportunity?

You’ll likely find that while the digital nomad life is cool (for a while)

You’ll be too excited by LIFE to spend it all in flip flops.

It would be my honor to be your guide.

If you’re ready…

===> Get all the details and join us here ​

Thanks,

James Camp

emails.content:
Hey, it’s James.

Happy Friday to you.

Fridays I like to zoom out a bit.

Synthesize, strategize, make some plans..

And I’ve got a quick observation for you:

Something that’s really stuck out for me answering your questions about the mentorship program these last few days…

Something that I really wasn’t expecting...

Is the number of investors looking for a new opportunity.

And I don’t just mean newbie investors.

I’m talking “seasoned” guys.

Guys with multi-million dollar real estate portfolios.

This is really significant.

It’s a BIG change.

And I’ll tell you what they’ve told me...

In times of turbulence, with lockdowns and whatever…

LOCAL REAL ESTATE IS RISKY.

When you have restrictions on travel…

On property viewings…

On supply chains…

All that stuff can make running a real estate business a PAIN.

I tried to flip a house a couple of years ago.

And I’ll just be up-front honest about this…

I nearly lost my shirt.

I made the mistake of taking a beaten up property and trying to do it up.

In short, I bought a BAD HOUSE.

What I should have done?

I should have bought somewhere with a careful tenant, made some small improvements, made some money and moved on.

Personally, I learned that in real estate there are just too many variables for the inexperienced.

So I won’t be playing that game again for the time being.

And I’m very grateful to be operating in a MUCH SAFER sandbox.

When you’re buying, improving and selling websites...

You can get in CHEAPER and FASTER than in physical real estate.

And once you’re in?

You can make a QUICK sale and pocket an ROI...

That is just NUTTY!

emails.subject: 💸  Micro Site Flip + Nano Flips is BACK BABY!
emails.content:
Welcome Back to Nano Flips!

​
​I know, you're sad, you haven't gotten an email in a while. I am too, but I'm here to fix that.

​
​Nano Thought

Capital markets are frothier than ever.

New spending bills recently passed by Congress mean the money printing will likely continue for the foreseeable future. It’s more important now than ever to own cash-flowing assets.

In an inflationary environment, one of the worst things you can do is sit on a large pile of cash. It’s important to put that money to work to make sure your're outpacing inflation and creating wealth.

With the frothiness in the market, it’s almost never been easier to grow an asset (like an ecommerce or content website) and sell it for a substantial amount.

​

With that in mind, if you’ve already built up a site and are looking to sell it, soon will be a great time! BFCM (Black Friday & Cyber Monday) just ended - Your valuation will get a boost since you can include the sales and ad revenue increase in your trailing 12 months revenue from Q4 of this year.

But remember- if you cash out, don’t keep that money on the sidelines for long!

​
​

This Week’s Nano Flip

I try to emphasize that you don’t need tons of money to get started in this game. There are tons of great deals you can do that just require a few hundred bucks.

This week, I want to highlight one of those deals.

I bought a dog frisbee site for $500 - it’s called BestDogFrisbee.com.

It’s a very simple affiliate site with blog posts linking to different dog frisbee options. The site is pretty barebones and was only making $13 a month at the time I bought it.
​

My goal is to make some simple changes and get the site to about $100 a month in profit immediately.

At that point, the site would be worth $3,600 or so - a 6x return on my initial investment that will take about 30 hours of work.

That’s an hourly rate of about $100 an hour when you factor in both the new value I could sell the site for and the cashflow I’ll generate each month.

Here are the changes we plan to make:
​

  1. Identify the 20 top keywords to target (“best dog frisbee” for example)
  2. Create new articles around those target keywords. Should publish one every two weeks.
  3. Update old articles; some mention the year 2020, so I’ll change those to 2022.
  4. Add comparison tables for the articles that talk about products. People love visuals.
  5. Make an exit intent pop up for chewy.com affiliate program
  6. Add Ezoic (programmatic display ads to run on non-product pages).
  7. Fix all broken affiliate links found on pages.

​

Obviously this isn’t the most lucrative project, but I want to show that it’s possible to start small and still make worthwhile money. If you’ve never flipped a site before, start with something like this and develop your own checklist and process before putting real money into a flip.

​

Cash flow from buying and selling digital real estate can be achievable all the way from tiny deals like this, to ones I work on currently (7-8 figures in revenue) all the way to taking a company public like BuzzFeed did into a SPAC at a $1.5 BILLION DOLLAR VALUATION (although that didn't go as planned):

​

​
​Where’s My Money?

This part of the newsletter is to remind you that there’s money everywhere. I’m going to prove it by highlighting a new lucrative business when possible that you’ve probably never heard of:

Did you know there are websites making $1M+ with Race Horses?

Without even risking money gambling on them, or putting up ANY money themselves?

Welcome to the world of fractional racehorse ownership.

The Site MyRaceHorse.com gives you the opportunity to buy a piece of a racehorse for as little as $50 for .01% ownership.

​

​

If the horse wins a race, you get a piece of the earnings.

What about the website owners? They are selling off slices of ownership at more than they are worth and pocket the difference between what you pay, and the horse actually costs.

Take an example from their website: The website owners are charging in total $292k

For a horse that costs $90k

And pocketing the difference...

(oh and they are taking a 2% management fee on top of the difference).

We broke down MyRaceHorse on my new podcast with my friends Colin and Oren, called Tab Talk.

​

Take a listen and subscribe here: https://anchor.fm/tabtalkio/​
​

Thanks from the Nano Flips team

​

(James)

​

P.S.

​

Need help on how to grow and monetize your site/business? Book a call with me!

​https://www.nanoflips.com/consultation​

emails.subject: 💸  $69 Billion in Cash and a Mommy Blog - Nano Flips Issue #9
emails.content:
Nano Flips Issue #9 - 2022 is Off to the Races!

​
Its 2022, time to start diving into the world of digital real estate. All the big players are!

​
​Nano Thought

Everyone keeps asking me what I think of the multiples that websites and other digital properties should be sold and bought for.

I sold my first site over 10 years ago. I sold it for 10x the monthly net revenue. When I first started Nano Flips, 30x was normal.

Now we are seeing more like 36-48x (depending on several factors).

This means that a site making $1k a month, should sell for $36k+. If its for sale for less BE WEARY!

We are still early! And if you are flipping this means even better news for you!

​
​

Nano Opportunity of the week

Mommy Blog on Motion Invest

​

​

Motion invest normally sells SUPER niche sites. So that has its upsides and downsides, but normally they are well priced and well built.

This site is monetized well, but would be perfect for building a newsletter for new moms using the incoming traffic.
​

ALSO

  • The site is linking to 510 products, of those, 102 are either out of stock or have an error.
  • Great opportunity to fix those links broken links and pull extra money from them.
  • The site is getting 14,797 visits a month, so conservatively we could gather 300+ new subscribers a month. This is a SUPER lucrative niche full of people spending money and looking to spend money.
  • After a year you would have 3600+ subscribers, and you should be able to make $1k a month of that list if monetized well.
  • Thats going to increase the value of the site by $36k at the end of the year!
  • In total with the growth and changes you would look at adding $40k+ of value to the site when you flip it + the money you make back by owning it

NOT A BAD ROI!

Don't forget to do your own research guys and use this as a framework of how to think. NOT as me saying to buy this site.

Check out the site for sale HERE​

Need help on how to build a newsletter? Check out my step by step below

CLICK TO READ MY THREAD ON HOW TO BUILD A NEWSLETTER

​
​Where is the money?

Maybe you heard? Microsoft is going gobble up Activision in $69 billion digital real estate bet

​

​

This is HUGE, and only leans into the idea of digital real estate. Owning digital assets is the future in more ways than one and Microsoft sees that here.

$69 Billion in an all cash deal is nothing to sneeze at.

The gaming developers that are now owned by Microsoft are some of the largest in the world, and are poised to take advantage of NFTs and digital real estate.

Every time i see a deal like this get done, all I can think is about how this all trickles down into making smaller sites and company valuations go higher as well.

How many website, social channels, and NFT opportunities are there that will come of this?

Endless

Check out more details of the deal here​

​
That Wraps up this week - Keep an eye out for a few things coming soon.

​

  1. Update on the dog frisbee case study site we bought recently
  2. A full site flip case being run on a DJ website from Flippa
  3. Announcement about our next cohort for our website flipping program (last one was amazing and over $500k+ of transactions took place because of it!)

​
​
​

Thanks from the Nano Flips team

​

(James)

emails.content:
Nano Flips Issue #10 - Jan is over M&A is heating up!

​
Gaming companies are getting bought up left and right. RIDE THE WAVE.

​
​Nano Thought

Not sure if you all saw or not but more large M&A has been happening in the digital world this week.

Sony has bought the video game studio Bungie for $3.6 BILLION. More about that here for those interested, but surely you'e wondering how this can benefit you.

Well. Not to sound like a broken record...but all ships rise on high tide, and there seems to be 2 ways for anyone to capitalize off this.

  1. Im pretty bullish on chip makers like AMD and NVIDIA
  2. BUY OR BUILD A GAMING WEBSITE OR NEWSLETTER

I know many of you out there are passionate about gaming, and I'm a big believer that it's growth isn't slowing down any time soon. If building from scratch, niche down into something that really interests you. If buying? Look for sites that is in gaming and is monetized with display ads.

Tons of opportunity if you monetize with a mobile gaming focused affiliate network where you get paid every time someone installs a game from an ad on your site.

Don't forget, any site monetized with Adsense is an opportunity for you to improve it with better advertising and flip it!
​

Want to hear more of my thoughts on M&A in the tech and gaming space? We dive into it (and a whole lot more) on episode 18 of our podcast, Tab Talk give it a listen and subscribe below

​
​

Take over the Knife Niche

​

​

Key Highlights

  • Site content (90 reviews and posts)
  • Keyword research list
  • Introduction to Buck Knives affiliate program manager
  • 30 days of email support to get you on your feet
  • A 3-year non-compete if requested

The opportunity

  • Find a specific affiliate deal for kitchen knives - Here is one - an easy $25 more a month from 1 sale
  • Introduce sponsored and paid guest posts - DR of 39, so we are going to sell 2 at $50 each a month
  • Continue the keyword research and target medium competition words
  • Invest in link building to support more competitive keywords and broader terms
  • Consider developing own products to sell on the site - BUILD AN EASY DROPSHIPPING STORE
  • Build out email list! - 10k visitors a month is an easy 100 extra subs
  • Create new content and increase product reviews
  • Ad Ezoic ads - Ezoic should add $25+ a month
  • ​

Kitchen knife affiliate: $25

Ezoic: $25

All ads up to an extra $100 a month - or $4k in value AND THAT DOESNT INCLUDE GROWING THE SITE!

If this sells for $11K earns, $4k over the year, and flip for $15k

Your ROI could be 72.73% or $8k

NOT A BAD ROI!

Don't forget to do your own research guys and use this as a framework of how to think. NOT as me saying to buy this site.

Ezoic shows us that smaller sites are eating the bigger ones!

​

they tell you

Hope the asset will rise in value?

No thanks​

We’re in the middle of a massive economic shift…

​

hype based investments are unstable…

​

People know they’re taking massive risks but

they realize they have to get wealthy now.

​

If they don’t lock-in a solid wealth building plan that allows them to CONTROL where they’ll be in 6, 9, 12 and 18 months?

They will get left behind.​

Thinking

HOPE.

​

and praying for “green days”...

​

Only to arrive at their birthday or New Year’s Eve with the

same Net Worth as last year.

Does that sound like a plan to you?​

Look
​

If you’re committed to building wealth.

I’m here to tell you:

THERE IS ANOTHER WAY.​

Hell no.

THEY ALL PUT MONEY INTO STUFF THEY CONTROL!

They aren’t gamblers.

​

Consider owning an asset that you fully control!

Own a Digital property

… and actively grow its value!

​

Rooting for ya,

James

emails.subject: huge news: we just exited a biz for $774K in cash!
emails.content:
Hey, It’s James

I’ve got some personal news for you…

So 3 days ago we exited one of our digital assets for $774k in cash!

Only took 12 months too.

“Happy for you James but why are you telling me this?”

Well…

Building wealth is great — but how you build it matters.

I’ve made this money…

WITHOUT having to buy into speculative investments

WITHOUT refreshing BTC or S&P500 charts 5 times a day

And certainly WITHOUT having any bosses or managing clients.

My crypto portfolio is down 50% from All Times High

But my Digital Real Estate Portfolio is thriving on green days and on red days.

Now…

If you want to build wealth and cash flow predictably…

There are only 3 simple rules you need to follow:

#1 Own assets YOU CONTROL.
​
(I don’t like refreshing charts 5 times a day)

#2 That DON’T REQUIRE YOUR TIME.
​
(I’m a lazy investor! haha)

#3 That YOU CAN BUY LOW, AND SELL HIGH.
​
​(I’m not a risk taker! I like assets where I can screw up so badly and still win big)

Now…

There’s so many opportunities out there!

​

You may have bought BTC, ETH, other crypto tokens or stocks.

(And realized your Net Worth could drop 50% overnight and

you have no control)​
​

You may have seen people start an agency (or even started your own!)

(And realized you now have 20 bosses and

you’ve invested 12 months of your life with no exit potential)

​

And you may have considered getting into real estate.

(And realized you need a lot of capital,

to be location dependent and to deal with annoying tenants)​
​

Finding the right opportunity that fits your lifestyle and goals can be a pain in the a**!​
​

And if you haven’t found yours yet… it’s not your fault.
​

See
​

Before discovering Digital Real Estate I was managing an agency…

​

… that I couldn’t sell

​

And it’s only when I started acquiring assets that I was able to sell it for $30M just a few years ago.

​

In fact

​

All of my friends have gotten wealthy in a similar way…

by owning businesses, real estate and digital assets.

​

And even though I’ve made millions by partaking in exits ranging

from $774K this month to $30M a few years earlier…

​

Digital Real Estate is STILL my wealth building vehicle of choice

​

Simply because

You can own an asset with very little upfront capital.

You get instant cash flow.

You can double, or triple your cash flow in 6-12 months and

sell it for x3 your investment or more!

Minimal investment.

Instant cashflow.

Control.

Exit potential for x3 or more within 12 months!

My kinda asset!

​

Now look

​

Even though I could easily ask for $5,000 or even $10,000 to help a small group of investors build their Digital Real Estate portfolios

​

because what I’m about to share with you has personally made me and my students millions

​

… i’m not gonna do that simply because my goal isn’t to get rich off of info products​
​

I’m a full time digital real estate investor (with skin in the game!)
​

And my goal here is to help others acquire their own digital real estate “freedom portfolio”.

​
To “monthly paychecks” with no bosses,

James

​

emails.subject: 💸  Hop in! Crypto is looking good, but websites are looking better!
emails.content:
​
​

​Nano Thought

Looks like we may see another bull run in crypto, who knows though. If you want to make life-changing money, I still think the best bet is owning your own businesses. You can spend time allocating your investments between stocks, ETFs, and crypto once you have a couple million.
​
And if you have less than $500k? Digital biz is still the best. Websites, newsletters, etc.
​
You’ve got to spend hundreds of thousands to buy $1,000 in cash flow from real estate, but you can spin up that amount of cash flow for far less with digital businesses.

​

​
​

DREEM Cohort

Want to thank all 100 of you that signed up for the DREEM cohort we are currently running. Sold out almost a week early!

Last cohort we saw about $500,000+ worth of websites bought by our students. Can't wait to see what happens with this new group!

Stay tuned for the sign-up for the next cohort.

​

Where's My Money: Case Study Update

As some of you may know, I'm on a mission to show you all that you don't need 10’s of thousands of dollars to flip a site. A few months ago, I bought a site for $400: A niche site based on frisbees for dogs. It was making about $11 a month.

In March we closed in on $30+
​
​

​
​

I know this isn't much in the scheme of things but you gotta start somewhere.

My checklist for improving this site:

  • Start cleaning up old content - A LONG WAY TO GO
  • Added a few pieces of new content - Going to keep adding
  • Built backlink through a guest post - Will keep building

At $100 a month, the site is easily worth $4k or so. If we combine that with our earnings over the time it takes to get there, we should easily pull $3,500+ in profit on this flip.

The goal here is to show you where you can start if you don't have a $50k+ budget. ANYBODY can do this.

​

Builders Build

I have a podcast called Builders Build with my friends Oren and Colin. If you haven't checked it out yet, get it on Spotify or Apple Podcasts​

​

​

We did an episode on Digital Assets, a topic that’s near and dear to all 3 of our hearts. We dove deep into every kind of digital asset, from niche content websites to social media profiles to Newsletters to saas to domains. Def worth a listen!

Make sure to like and subscribe!
​
​Link to the Episod​e On Spotify​

​Link to the Episode on iTunes​

​

​

Nano Opportunity

Here’s a site doing $490 a month in profit selling for $11k on Flippa:

​

​Link to the listing​

Sometimes the trick is to optimize sites for improvements.

Other times?

Its M&A - This site would be a great one to buy if you own a portfolio of gaming sites, or anything where your audience would need a good chair. You could backlink and guest post between the 2 businesses.

Or just hold it for semi-passive income

If you REALLY had it in you, start dropshipping chairs from Alibaba or carrying inventory yourself. Convert the site from affiliate to a real ecommerce store. Would DRASTICALLY change income. Just less passive.

​

Well thanks as always guys! Excited to bring you guys some weekly alpha.

​

Thanks from the Nano Flips team

​

(James)

​

​

​

emails.subject: 💸 Leather Site Selling for $18k - How to Turn It Into $160K+
emails.content:
Nano Thought

Multiples have been going up for years. Everyone always asks me, "James isn't that a bad thing?"

The answer is NO. We WANT higher multiples!

If you flip a website, the higher multiple means more gain when you sell! Also, we want this industry to mature. It brings in more buyers, and sellers, and makes the ecosystem better for all of us. Stop thinking there is too much competition. There are billions of websites and infinite opportunity.

Here's a good thought about competition:

Higher multiples are usually a sign of more investment dollars flowing into the space. More demand from investors for an asset class is good for anyone involved in the space.

So even if you're paying more for a website because multiples are higher, you'll be able to sell it for much more.

​

This Week’s Nano Flip Opportunity

Found a great deal a few days ago on Flippa.

I've looked at thousands of listings for websites, and some are stronger than others. This one jumps out as a good opportunity because the website is already performing well, and there's some clear changes I could make right away to boost revenue and the re-sale value of the site.

Check out the listing:

​

​

​Link to the listing​

​

This site is doing $453 a month and selling for $13,100 (but it's an auction, so the price will end higher).

I would say the site should sell for a 36-40x multiple, which would be $16,000-18,000, based on my experience. I'm NOT recommending this, but at this size you could finance the purchase with a loan and $5k or less of your own cash. Amex offered me a personal loan recently at 0%, and there are all sorts of other lenders out there. This deal would likely be too small for an SBA loan, but that's an option for larger deals. Again, I would not take out a loan to finance this.

With some small changes, one could possibly 2x the revenue in the short term, and 3x it in the long term.

For the short term I'd recommend:

  1. Updating the roughly 33% of “out of stock” products from the site!!
  2. Adding multiple monetization channels such as Ezoic​
  3. Finding alternative private affiliates in the leather niche that pay better commissions than Amazon Associates
  4. Creating an emailing list/newsletter
  5. Building more social channels to drive traffic
  6. Making design more user friendly
  7. Link building and authoritative links
  8. Improving the contextual relevance of the content
  9. Keyword analysis for better ranking

Changing the ad network and making the above improvements might 2x the revenue in the first month or so.

That's cool but not even the most exciting part.

If we double the $453 revenue of the site to $906 and the site is worth 40x monthly net, the site is now worth $36,240

But this site is also doing 9k unique visitors a month or so. If we get 3% of them onto a newsletter about the niche, that's an extra 270 subs a month, or 3,240 at the end of a year.

Lets say 3k end of the year, as some will unsubscribe. If you built a good info product or added affiliate products to the newsletter, you should be able to pull $1 a month per subscriber.

So after a year, let's say you've just doubled the monthly revenue from the site and created a new income stream from a newsletter.

You're now earning $906 from the website and $3,000 a month from the email newsletter (minus some costs, so let's say the net is $2,500 on the newsletter). That's $3,406 in net income a month, making the site worth....

$136,240.

So in the first year, you've made:

$10,872 from the website

$14,000 from the newsletter (You had to build this up over the year, so you made $250 the first month, $500 the second month, etc)

That's $24,872 in income, plus your asset is now worth $136k..

...All from a $18,000 investment.

That's a 794% return.

Of course, this is just one scenario that may or may not play out. But it illustrates how flipping websites lets you "double dip" into the profits. First, you pocket the money that the website makes. Next, you can sell the website for a lot more because of the increased profits.

Not bad for a part time hustle

With a little work this could all be possible. As always, do your own due diligence and research! You should look at hundreds of deals before actually doing one. Looking at tons of deals helps you understand the market and narrow down your investment criteria.

​
​Nano Tips

This week my partners and I did an entire breakdown of our favorite plugins for Wordpress on our podcast Builders Build.

We normally talk about how we build our business, and I think you will enjoy every other episode. We talk about a variety of industries and types of businesses, so if nothing else, you'll get some ideas about how we've created and scaled businesses.

90% of the sites we buy, build, and flip are built on Wordpress, so we've figured out a good system for which plugins to use.

Take our combined 30+ years of experience with building websites and businesses using Wordpress as the backbone, to help you jump right into having a fast, secure, SEO friendly website.

Check it out:

Thanks from the Nano Flips team

Changing the ad network and making the above improvements might 2x the revenue in the first month or so.

That's cool but not even the most exciting part.

If we double the $453 revenue of the site to $906 and the site is worth 40x monthly net, the site is now worth $36,240

But this site is also doing 9k unique visitors a month or so. If we get 3% of them onto a newsletter about the niche, that's an extra 270 subs a month, or 3,240 at the end of a year.

Lets say 3k end of the year, as some will unsubscribe. If you built a good info product or added affiliate products to the newsletter, you should be able to pull $1 a month per subscriber.

So after a year, let's say you've just doubled the monthly revenue from the site and created a new income stream from a newsletter.

You're now earning $906 from the website and $3,000 a month from the email newsletter (minus some costs, so let's say the net is $2,500 on the newsletter). That's $3,406 in net income a month, making the site worth....

$136,240.

So in the first year, you've made:

$10,872 from the website

$14,000 from the newsletter (You had to build this up over the year, so you made $250 the first month, $500 the second month, etc)

That's $24,872 in income, plus your asset is now worth $136k..

...All from a $18,000 investment.

That's a 794% return.

Of course, this is just one scenario that may or may not play out. But it illustrates how flipping websites lets you "double dip" into the profits. First, you pocket the money that the website makes. Next, you can sell the website for a lot more because of the increased profits.

Not bad for a part time hustle

With a little work this could all be possible. As always, do your own due diligence and research! You should look at hundreds of deals before actually doing one. Looking at tons of deals helps you understand the market and narrow down your investment criteria.

We normally talk about how we build our business, and I think you will enjoy every other episode. We talk about a variety of industries and types of businesses, so if nothing else, you'll get some ideas about how we've created and scaled businesses.

90% of the sites we buy, build, and flip are built on Wordpress, so we've figured out a good system for which plugins to use.

Take our combined 30+ years of experience with building websites and businesses using Wordpress as the backbone, to help you jump right into having a fast, secure, SEO friendly website.

emails.subject: 💸 Want to make USD $23,590/mo? Here is Your Chance With a Food Blog
emails.content:
Nano Thought

Mortgage rates are spiking this year. The average 30-year rate has gone from around 3% last year to about 6% now. I really should've locked in a low mortgage last year on a place!

But that's a lesson that can be applied to all aspects of business: You can't time the market.

James Camp 🛠,🛠
@JamesonCamp
My greatest regret in life is not getting a mortgage in 2021
April 22nd 2022
108
Retweets
2,948
Likes

People love to debate if mortgage rates will dip from here or keep spiking up. While it may be fun to debate, it's a completely pointless exercise. You almost certainly won't time the market, and even if you do, it will be total luck.

My advice: Get to building so that your cash flow and net worth are so huge that a 0.5% change in rates won't matter at all.

Instead of waiting for rates to dip down so you can just barely afford the house you want, spend that energy on doubling your income so that you can easily afford it.

Stop trying to time the market. The stock market, mortgage rate market, website flipping market, etc. You probably won't. Just get to work building assets and compounding.

​

This Week’s Nano Flip Opportunity

Found some great deals on Flippa recently that I think are worth highlighting. One is a bit bigger than the other to be honest. But let's start with the larger one.

To be candid, overall I would try and stay away from businesses that are attached to a name or personality. But every once in a while you find one that's super interesting and would still work as an acquisition.

Check out the listing:

​

​

​

​Link to the listing​

The seller is claiming that income 100% is passive. Anybody who knows me knows I'm skeptical of full passive income claims, since owning any business means doing some work.

With that said they have strong traffic and display ad revenue. $316,000 gross in 2021. These numbers are NUTTY!

Let's say you buy this business with financing, either with an SBA loan or private loan, for about $100k down. Here's what the numbers look like on that:

  • $1,095,000 Purchase Price
    • $100,000 down
    • $995,000 financed
  • 10 year loan at 6% Interest
  • $11,046.54 monthly loan payment
  • New Net Income: $12,543.46/mo

With the company's existing net profit of $23,590, you could cover your loan cost and still net $12,543.46 per month.

That's a net income of $150,521.52 in the first year, or a 150% return on your initial down payment.

I find this interesting as a buy and hold, not as a flip. Even without any value-add strategy to increase revenues, this could still be a great investment if you can keep net income where it is.

It could also be a very strategic buy for a media company in the food or lifestyle niche. As always due your own due diligence, and the above is just a possible outcome.

I know you guys want to look at more affordable sites..so let's take a look at one below:

​

​Link to Listing​

This is a really basic website that makes $605/month with affiliate links and display advertising. Its simplicity is a good thing and a bad thing to be honest:

This can be great because it wouldn't REALLY require a ton of maintenance, the seller has done a good job building it.

The bad part is that this kind of website can honestly be made by anyone who knows what they are doing. Anyone else could target these exact same keywords and outsource the articles pretty easily. The site's backlink profile isnt THAT high-authority, and the keywords would be pretty easy to target for competitors.

The Flippa Listing states the site is on Ezoic Premium, which means you need to account for those costs.

I'd say this site is worth about $20k or so if its making $600 a month. Not a quick flip, but major potential in the long run.

​

​
​Nano Tips

This week on our podcast Builders Build we switch up the 3 musketeer format and bring in an amazing guest, Joe Valley, author of The EXITpreneur’s Playbook.

Joe is a serial entrepreneur, EXITpreneur, M&A Advisor, Podcaster and Partner at Quiet Light Brokerage, one of the top online business brokerage-advisory firms in the world.

Joe has also built, bought, or sold over half a dozen of his own companies!

We cover everything from setting business goals, to tools and strategies to help document your processes and resources from the start (SOPs, metrics, accounting, etc). We also talk about picking metrics for your business, valuing businesses, where to sell, and more.

Learn how to sell your online business for top dollar by reverse engineering your pathway to success.

​

emails.subject: 💸 You Could Make $85,029 with 1 change to this Jet Ski Website
emails.content:
Nano Thought

We spend so much of our lives worrying what others think. I didn't start this newsletter for years because I thought nobody would like it. But here we are with 9,700 subscribers!
​
Just goes to show that you never know how something will do until you put it out in the marketplace. Some of my "best" ideas ended up being flops, while projects I doubted and put off ended up my being my biggest successes.

So do yourself a favor: Realize that you're probably the worst judge of how well your own ideas will do. The best judge is the first few potential customers you put your idea in front of.

James Camp 🛠,🛠
@JamesonCamp
I turned 34 today and something really clicked for me Everyone’s going to die, and nobody is going to remember you So screw it… Relentlessly go for what you want as hard as you can with unbridled passion
May 1st 2022
89
Retweets
897
Likes

Also, you won't be here forever. Take a few swings at living the type of life you really want. After a lot of thinking and trying different businesses, I realized that owning digital real estate (online businesses) provided the ideal lifestyle for me. I could make great money, and I also could live wherever and travel without having to be tethered to a specific location.

Maybe you're not wired exactly like me, but if you're subscribed to this newsletter you probably have a similar interest. Trust me, it's a great business to be in. If it's your dream, make sure you give it at least one or two solid attempts to make it work. I don't think you'll regret it!

​

This Week’s Nano Flip Opportunity

​

I found this affiliate site for sale that's focused on the jet ski niche. The site's selling for $6,050 and profits $598/mo, so it's selling for about 10x monthly earnings. That multiple is fairly low, so I assume the auction for this site will end up a bit higher. Maybe for $15-20k.

​

​Link to Listing​

When I look at buying a site, the first thing I look at is what I can improve.

It's okay to buy a site and just collect the existing profit, but the real money is made on value-add investing.

What can you do to improve the asset so that cashflow doubles or triples?

Here are the areas of improvement the seller mentions in the listing:

  • Offering digital marketing services to jet ski hire business owners
  • Creating exclusive affiliate programs with eCommerce brands
  • Split-testing more jet ski business insurance lead offers
  • Brand sponsorships with Kawasaki, Yamaha and Sea-Doo
  • Creating a paid community
  • Creating an email list
  • Dropship jetski accessories
  • Selling backlinks to other websites
  • Improving and adding new content
  • Creating a marketing strategy

I think all of those are good options to look into, but there's one of them in particular I would prioritize: Build an email list.

Email lists are some of the most valuable types of media properties you can have today. A newsletter with just a few of thousand subscribers can be more valuable than a website that gets hundreds of thousands of views a month.

Let's run some numbers: According to the listing, the website got 177,073 website visitors in the last 12 months. If you get the same amount of visitors over the next 12 months and convert 2% of them to email subscribers, you'd have a list of 3,541 subscribers

Again, 1 email subscriber is many times more valuable than 1 website visitor. Instead of hoping that a user remembers your brand and makes the effort to return to your website later, you can just show up right in their inbox every single week.

In my experience, you can monetize an email subscriber at a rate of about $0.50 to $1 per month. So adding an email list for this website could mean:

  • $3,541 in additional monthly revenue
  • $42,492 in additional annual revenue
  • ~$85k higher valuation for your website

Building even a small email list can mean a huge boost in revenue and big bump in your selling price if you decide to flip the site!

As always, do your own research! This is a hypothetical scenario.

​

Nano Tips

​

This week on our podcast Builders Build we talk about how you can create captivating content for your business.

We explain our own processes for creating content, debate on using a personal brand vs. a corporate brand, messaging exercises, hiring contractors, and more.

This just scratches the surface of the vast world of content creation, but I think it's a good starting point if you're looking to get a content flywheel going for your own brand.

​

​

emails.content:
Nano Thought

It's a blood bath in the markets this week. Stocks and crypto both getting hammered.

Of course I invest in stocks, ETFs, and crypto, but I'm always preaching that you shouldn't rely on investments for your main source of income. Markets go up and down, so you have to know there will be months when you lose money in the markets.

My advice: Control your own destiny by building or buying a business that produces cash flow.

James Camp 🛠,🛠
@JamesonCamp
If you're freaking out about crypto and stocks today and don't take this as a sign that you need to buy or build your own business ASAP I don't know what to tell you
May 9th 2022
12

Likes

You might make or lose a fortune in crypto, but you have no control over how the markets will do. The surest way to build wealth is to first own a business that produces profit. Keep building the business to increase your income, and as you get wealthy, you can diversify into stocks, real estate, and crypto.

​

Apparently most of you think the market will get worse before it gets better. If that's the case, then it's a great time to get busy building a business while everyone else is worried about the market.

​

This Week’s Nano Flip Opportunity

​

Today's Nano Flip Opportunity is a listing on Flippa: It's an air purifier and ionizer affiliate site that generates $616 in monthly profit.

Using a 40x monthly multiple, let's say this site is worth $24,640.

​

​

​

​Link to Listing​

If you bought it, how would you improve the site, increase profits, and flip it for 2x-3x what you paid? Here's what I'd do:

The first change I'd make is switching from Adsense to Ezoic for display ads. In my experience, this can double ad revenue. The seller agrees with me. Here's what the listing says:

"If you are better at Adsense than me, or have Adthrive, Mediavine, Ezoic, etc, then I’d imagine there’d be significantly more to be made from ads on the site."

I'd also add a new stream of revenue: Sell sponsored blog posts for $50. I think it would be fairly easy to sell 2 of those a month to advertisers looking to build backlinks, and you could scale that stream of revenue as you build up a book of advertisers.

Here's my list of improvements I'd make:

  • Build backlinks
  • Build content for new low hanging fruit keywords
  • Switch to Ezoic​
  • Drop ship products
  • Carry inventory & sell direct to customers
  • Sell sponsored blog posts

Here's what I'd expect revenue to look like a few months after buying the site:

  • $100/mo in sponsored posts
  • $750 in Amazon sales monthly (currently the site does about $500/mo from Amazon)
  • $250 in Ezoic ads (currently the site does about $125 a month)

New monthly revenue = $1,100

Using that same 40x multiple, the site would theoretically be worth $44,000.

That's nearly a 2x on your initial investment, not factoring in the profit you'd be collecting each month.

Let's say that you take 6 months to implement these changes and ramp up revenue. You'd collect $5,196 over those 6 months, and you'd also be sitting on an asset worth $44,000.

That's a $49,196 return on a $24,640 investment, or $24,556 in profit (a 102% return!)

As always, do your own research! This is a hypothetical scenario.

​

Nano Tips

I've written about how email newsletters are among the best ways to increase the value of your website. If you can convert just 2% of your website visitors to a newsletter, you build a recurring revenue stream worth somewhere around $0.25 to $1 per month per subscriber.

It may not be a lot at first, but once you have thousands of readers signed up for your email list, you can drastically increase your revenue.

This week on Builders Build, we chatted about how to build a business around email newsletters with Jack Raines, a rising star in the content & newsletter businesses.

emails.subject: 💸  A $30k website - Here's How You Can Turn It Into a $60k Website
emails.content:
Nano Thought

We might already be in a recession. Do you have a plan to not only survive, but prosper in a down economy?

Lots of people still do well in a recession. Airbnb, Netflix, and plenty of other huge companies started during recessions.

Here's my advice: You need to own an audience.

If you document your expertise and build a following around your personal brand, you'll never run out of opportunities. You can sell a consulting service, partner up as an affiliate for products your audience would like, sell a course, or a hundred other things.

The bottom line is, you need to own the audience. It's risky to just have your audience on Twitter or another platform you don't control. Get them on your website or newsletter as well as your social media profiles.

This Week’s Nano Flip Opportunity

​

This week we're looking at a camera website.

Based on the monthly revenue and a 36x monthly revenue multiple, I'd say this site is worth $30k or so.

​

​

​Link to Listing​

You may know my formula by now: I only buy sites that I know I can grow substantially.

You can probably do fine if you buy these sites and just keep them where they are revenue-wise, but the really money comes from increasing the value of the asset.

Here's what I'd do:

  • Sell 2 sponsored posts a month at $100 each
  • Build a newsletter by adding a lead magnet and opt-in popup to the website

A newsletter is insanely valuable for a brand. Instead of relying on your customers to remember you and order later, you know have their contact info and can reach out regularly with a newsletter.

This site gets over 9,000 unique visitors a month. Convert 2% of those into newsletter subscribers, and you're 180 people to your list every single month.

In my experience, a newsletter subscriber is worth $0.25 to $0.50 per month in a niche like this. So each month you'd be adding an additional $45 to $90 in incremental monthly revenue.

Let's say after 6 months of making those changes, you've increased the monthly revenue of the website from $839 to $1,444, just from the 2 sponsored posts and my new email list.

That doesn't even factor in changes you could make to the site's content, SEO strategy, or affiliate programs that could increase revenue.

Let's say you're also able to grow the existing revenue at 2% per month with those changes (Thats pretty conservative). After 6 months, the site's total new revenue would be $1,532.

So in 6 months, you would have created an incremental $693 in revenue, which means:

  • $8,316 in additional annual revenue
  • $24,948 additional value of the website

So after buying this site for $30k, you'd have collected 6 month's worth of revenue plus you'd be able to sell the asset for about $25k more than you paid for it.

Without even crunching the numbers, you can see that you'd easily clear a 100% return on investment.

As always, do your own research! This is a hypothetical scenario.

​

​

Nano Thought

Remember your first dollar made online?

It changes everything.

I've heard a few people say something like "$1 made from your own business feels like $1,000 made from a paycheck." Once you get that first taste of making money online and working for yourself, you're hooked.

James Camp 🛠,🛠
@JamesonCamp

Likes

If you haven't made your first dollar online yet, I encourage you to do whatever you can to get started. Nothing is too small to start with. Some of the most successful entrepreneurs I know only made a few hundred bucks online in their first year as entrepreneurs. But they learned and kept building.

This Week’s Nano Flip Opportunity

This week's Nano Flip Opportunity is an affiliate site in the cycling and fitness niche.

​Link to Listing​

The site made $527 last month, which gives it a run rate of $6,324 per year. Like I've said with every other flip, it's only worth doing one of these deals if you can substantially increase the income of the site. You'll make a bit of money if you buy the site and do nothing, but the real opportunity is improving the cash flow and the overall value of the asset.

I see a lot of opportunity with this site. One thing I don't like is that the word "Peloton" is in the domain name, which could possibly get the owner into some legal trouble with the Peloton brand.

But let's start with the improvements. Here's what the listing for the site says:

"Buyers can quickly scale up the site simply by following an aggressive content creation strategy to increase traffic and income in a short span of time. There is also an opportunity to host guest posts and sign up for different display ad and affiliate platforms to multiply sources of income."

Speaking of affiliate platforms and ad networks, I'd immediately switch the site to Ezoic, which typically helps to improve the revenue of content sites that I own.

Here's how the numbers might work out for this deal:

  • $21,080 purchase price (assuming a 40x multiple of monthly profit)
  • $527 in monthly profit/$6,324 per year before any changes

and here are some changes you could make:

  • +25% revenue growth by updating content & switching to Ezoic
  • +$200 per month for hosting guests posts
  • +$231 per month by adding a newsletter with a 2% sign up rate

New cash flow = $1,090/month

With just those 2 changes, its possible you could cash flow around $13,080 in the first year. If you wanted to sell the site, it would be worth about $43,600 using the same 40x multiple from earlier.

Let's say you sell it after 1 year for $43,600. You'd bring in $56,680 (the sale price + the cash flow from the previous 12 months) on an investment of $21,080 (original purchase price of the website).

That would be a return of $35,600, or 168% on your original investment!

Now you see how lucrative website flipping can be. You get paid twice: Once on the monthly cash flow, and then again when you re-sell the improved website for more than you paid.

If you didn't make any of those changes and just kept cash flow at $527 a month, you'd break-even after about 3 years. That's still decent when compared to other investments.

Remember, this is a hypothetical example, with just some guesses about numbers! Always do your own research and formulate your own projections based off your skills.
